Common questions

Is the football lineup builder free to use?

Yes. The web builder runs in your browser, free, with no account. The iOS and Android apps are free too.

Do I need to create an account?

No. Open the builder and start building. It remembers the last team you opened on this device. To save up to 100 lineups and keep them, install the free MyLineups app.

Which formations are supported?

20+ preset formations, including 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1, 3-5-2, 4-4-2 and 5-3-2, and you can drag any player anywhere on the pitch. The app's Lineup format also takes a lineup from 2 to 11 players.

Can I change the kit, the colors or the pitch?

On the web, every club wears its real home kit on a single pitch theme. Pitch themes, other kits and Team colors live in the app.

How do I share a lineup I built?

Copy link puts a link on your clipboard that reopens the exact same lineup on any device. Download exports it as a square image.

Is this the same tool as the MyLineups app?

The web builder is the lite version. The app adds 12,000+ real players with photos, custom players, goals, cards, ratings and subs through Player info, Team colors, the manager on the sheet, and up to 100 saved lineups.

About the web builder

The MyLineups web builder is a free football lineup builder that runs in your browser. Pick any of 400+ clubs and national teams, each in its real home kit, set one of 20+ formations and drag every player into place. Player info toggles show numbers, country flags and club badges on the sheet. Copy link shares a link that reopens the exact same lineup; Download exports it as a square image. The free iOS and Android app adds 12,000+ real players, custom players, goals, cards, ratings, subs, Team colors and up to 100 saved lineups.

Keep building in the app

Import any club or fixture, add goals, cards and ratings with Player info, then export it in your Team colors. Free on iOS and Android.
